intent: Continue the existing owner-only Hebrew RTL research dashboard and individually isolated researcher workspaces. Implement stored applications, contributions, immutable agreement negotiations and approvals, private documents, exact-version findings publication, consent-filtered allowlisted analysis, and fail-closed verified provider signing with immutable executed evidence. Preserve existing research, questionnaire, security and professional communication behavior; all development is synthetic and local, with no production migration, real mail, provider activation or deployment.

evidence: app/lib/research-partnership-ui.js:53 -- async function leaveEditor(next){const current=editor;while(current&&(current.dirty||current.saving)){if(!await current.save())return;if(editor!==current)return;}return next();}

triage_groups.title: Publication, consent and private documents
triage_groups.context: Separate permission, exact publication, current source consent and byte-download checks are inconsistent across projections.
triage_groups.preferred_resolution: Address #2 and #3 in shared authoritative read guards, then #4 and #11 in the kind-aware document gate; verify each denial and each intended release.
triage_groups.why: Shared guards prevent one response path from undoing another path's privacy check; the findings have distinct failure modes and remain separate.

triage_groups.title: Draft and agreement state
triage_groups.context: The editor loses failed saves and does not restore persisted approval or amendment context.
triage_groups.preferred_resolution: Fix #1 first, hydrate exact-version receipts for #5, then populate the executed source pointer for #6.
triage_groups.why: Preserving unsaved data comes before agreement workflow and display fixes.

triage_groups.title: Provider signing recovery
triage_groups.context: Provider calls and local durable state can diverge on transient failures.
triage_groups.preferred_resolution: Make #10 track or reconcile external envelope creation, and make #8 retry an incomplete verification rather than replay its preliminary receipt.
triage_groups.why: Creation and refresh fail at different boundaries; fixing one does not repair the other.

requirements.evidence: Existing shell/client, fixed RPC authorization and UI components are reused. Original auditList remains available; new mutations call the existing private metadata-only audit.
Owner search/study/status/kind filters, pending counts, deadlines and folder links exist; researchers receive scoped workspaces.
Structured application fields and immutable stored transitions exist; failed draft saves can lose edits.
Individual folders, nested-reference checks and same-study isolation exist; intended released attachment access is incomplete.
Exact-version approval/publication/viewer and withdrawal controls exist; current-consent reads and separate byte-download checks have gaps.
Approved-findings and collaborative-analysis presets exist without replacing prior explicit grants; own-folder result reads bypass the intended release boundary.
Structured requests and owner-only fixed operations exist; release guards, cohort comparison and result attachments need correction.
Eight contribution categories, seven statuses, immutable proposals and separate agreed terms exist; approvals alone remain nonbinding.
All twelve sections, data reuse, missing fields, Hebrew preview and exports exist with explicit legal/template dependencies; save failure handling needs repair.
Immutable revisions, exact comparisons and same-version/hash approvals exist; persisted approval receipts are not restored in the UI.
IP acknowledgement is separate and executed evidence immutable; the UI cannot create the required correctly linked amendment.
Stored invitations are expiring, individual-bound, revocable and single use; the delivered fragment route does not open acceptance.
Provider identity/authority, consent, two signatures, evidence and fail-closed readiness exist; creation/refresh failure recovery needs repair.
Obligations are extracted only from verified execution, retain source/clause references and require owner review; unsigned proposals remain nonbinding.
Encrypted private documents and scoped reads/exports exist; original-byte download permission and kind-specific released reads are inconsistent.
Participant contracting remains separate and connector readiness is honest; withdrawal is not enforced on every released source-backed read.

Unapplied migration, functional source, synthetic SQL/HTTP tests, browser evidence and Hebrew setup/readiness notes exist. Review fixes and final verification remain; DOCX visual rendering is transparently unverified.

implementation_units.evidence: Reconciled research/security foundation is already present at base ec99d64 and reused; original source checkouts and production are outside this review.
Shared vocabulary, validation, transitions and export contracts exist; recordGet must retain approval receipts.
Private schema, immutable history, CAS/receipts and authorization are implemented; release/consent/document and refresh semantics need correction.
Typed gateway, encryption, exports, readiness and verified signing adapter exist; invitation routing and provider-state recovery need correction.
Existing RTL interface has the requested overview, folders, forms and dependency states; save/reload/amendment/invitation workflows need correction.
Local synthetic verification and documentation exist; the actionable review findings and their regression checks must be completed before final local delivery.

requirements_completeness.note: All planned capabilities have implementation paths; partial entries map to concrete findings. Missing operational/legal inputs are explicit plan dependencies, not omitted product scope.

testing_gaps: Cross-study nested references: add a same-researcher/different-study negative test for supportingDocumentIds, sourceSnapshotId and agreement version references (harness/tests/research-partnership-database.test.mjs:59). The SQL currently checks study and partner; this is a consequential security test gap, not a demonstrated authorization defect.

Verified signer identity: vary provider email/name, clientUserId and identity workflow independently while consent and verification remain positive, and assert no execution (harness/tests/research-signing.test.mjs:71). The adapter currently enforces these matches; the missing negative cases are a security test gap.
